close_reason: Updated crate-level doc and ValidationPolicy doc; NC is implemented in v0.1
description: lib.rs crate-level doc (line 26) and ValidationPolicy doc (line 289) both say 'v0.1 does not implement NameConstraints' — but the feature is now implemented. A caller reading the crate docs will believe NC is silently skipped and may rely on that misstatement, leading to security bypasses in environments that audit documentation rather than code.
title: module doc still lists NameConstraints as unimplemented
